messages:
maya: Customer ACME opened a ticket — high latency (800-1200ms) and occasional 503s. They say requests are landing in us-west-2 but their app is in eu-west-1 and they pinned the region. sample request ids: req_01F6X, req_01F6Y. Can someone check routing/failover config?

james: Seen a few similar alerts this morning in monitoring. Frontend shows initial route to eu-west-1 then fallback to us-west-2 on several requests. 503s line up with fallback attempts. Any recent changes to failover policy?

li: Looking at the routing config for ACME tenant. Quick dump shows failover policy looks like this: 
```json
{"failover_policy": {"priority": ["us-west-2","eu-west-1"], "weights": {"us-west-2": 80, "eu-west-1": 20}, "sticky": true}}
```
That priority/weights are reversed from what we expected for EU-first customers. Sticky routing is enabled, so once a client fell back to us-west-2 subsequent requests stayed there.

maya: Oof. How did that get applied? This tenant set "region_preference": "eu-west-1" in the console.

li: I suspect a rollout bug in the config templating when we expanded the region alias mapping last week — priority array got assembled in alphabetical order instead of honoring tenant preference. Will escalate to infra patch.

james: For immediate mitigation: can we flip policy for ACME and flush sticky sessions? Steps I recommend: 
1) PATCH admin routing API to set priority ["eu-west-1","us-west-2"] and weights {eu:90, us:10} for tenant acme
2) POST to /internal/routing/flush_sticky?tenant=acme to clear sticky cache
3) Monitor request_id latency and 503 rate

li: Prepared curl commands: 
```
curl -X PATCH "https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/tenants/acme/routing" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"failover_policy": {"priority": ["eu-west-1","us-west-2"], "weights": {"eu-west-1": 90, "us-west-2": 10}, "sticky": false}}'

curl -X POST "https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/routing/flush_sticky?tenant=acme" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
I'll apply now in staging then prod after smoke tests.

routing-bot: deploy started: routing-config-rollback-fix (li). CI smoke checks pending.

maya: Also forwarding to customer: please include a short repro we can run (region header + sample curl) — they gave frontend logs but not raw curl yet.

maya: (to customer) Can you run: 
```
curl -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
and paste the X-Request-Id and timings?

carlos (fwrd from customer): Sent back: when I run the curl I see initial 302 -> eu, then next request 200 OK from us-west-2 and RTT ~1100ms. Req ids: req_01F6X, req_01F6Y. Token was issued in eu region.

li: Applied config change in prod at 1749502800, sticky flush issued. routing-bot: smoke passed in prod.

routing-bot: config deploy complete: routing-config-rollback-fix — all services OK.

james: Monitoring update: tail of request latencies for tenant acme (last 10m) down to 120-160ms median, 503s dropped to 0. Sample req req_01F6X now serviced in eu-west-1.

maya: Customer updated: confirmed latency back to ~150ms and no 503s, thanks. They also noted unexpected cross-region egress charges — pinging billing to audit.

billing-bot: Noted ~2GB cross-region egress billed for ACME in the incident window. Created ticket BILL-992 for manual review and potential credit.

li: Root cause writeup draft: config templating bug created inverted priority list for some tenant-prefilled routes; sticky routing caused sticky sessions to persist on fallback region. Remediation: patched templating code to respect explicit tenant region_preference and added unit test + integration test for ordering; added telemetry alert for unusual cross-region sticky fallbacks.

james: Follow ups: 1) add a scatter of unit tests on region order, 2) add an operational runbook for flushing sticky routing cache (one-click in console), 3) check other tenants flagged by telemetry.

maya: Thanks team. Closing support ticket after billing follow-up. :thumbsup:

li: Closing note — rolled out fix in 3 regions at 1749503000. Will watch overnight and escalate if anything else pops up.

maya: Marking resolved on our side.
